verdict.rationale: mParticle has extensive documented public HTTP/Platform APIs (events, Warehouse Sync API, Audiences API, Real-time API) that allow programmatic control comparable to what an AI-native agent would need to drive the product. However, there's no explicit evidence of AI-agent-specific tooling (e.g., OpenAPI spec discoverability, SDKs marketed for agentic use, or third-party agent integration reports). Missing for 10: explicit machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/Swagger) evidence, independent/hands-on confirmation of API usability by an autonomous agent.
